jobs.title: Director of Analytics Engineering
jobs.description:
DIRECTOR OF ANALYTICS ENGINEERING

Remote (U.S.)

Up to $235,000 Base + Bonus + Benefits

The Opportunity

We're partnering with a rapidly growing, technology-driven organization to hire a Director of Analytics
who will lead analytics strategy, analytics engineering, and customer-facing data products.

This is not a traditional BI leadership role.
We're looking for an engineering-minded analytics leader who has grown from a background in software engineering, data engineering, or analytics engineering and still enjoys being close to architecture, data modeling, platform strategy, and technical decision-making.

You'll lead a talented team while helping shape the future of the company's analytics, reporting, AI, and customer-facing data product strategy.

What Makes This Role Unique

Own both internal analytics and customer-facing analytics products
Lead a highly visible analytics organization with strong executive sponsorship
Drive modernization across analytics architecture, self-service analytics, and AI-powered insights
Influence product, engineering, and data strategy at the leadership level
Opportunity to help define the future of analytics and AI within the organization

What You'll Be Doing

Own the analytics vision, roadmap, and long-term strategy
Lead Analytics Engineering, Reporting, and Client Analytics teams
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, AI, and Executive Leadership
Drive adoption of scalable analytics architecture and engineering best practices
Define and govern semantic layers, business metrics, and self-service analytics capabilities
Scale customer-facing analytics products and embedded reporting experiences
Guide AI-enabled analytics initiatives, conversational analytics, and modern decision-support products
Mentor and develop a high-performing analytics organization

What We're Looking For

Required Background

10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Analytics Engineering
5+ years leading analytics, analytics engineering, or data engineering teams
Strong experience owning analytics strategy and delivery in SaaS or B2B environments
Proven success building and scaling analytics teams and data products

Technical Requirements

Strong expertise with Snowflake architecture, optimization, governance, and data modeling
Hands-on knowledge of Looker, including semantic layers, metric governance, LookML, and self-service analytics
Deep SQL expertise and strong understanding of modern analytics engineering principles
Experience with dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, dbt, and enterprise data architecture
Ability to lead technical discussions with engineers, architects, and executive stakeholders

Preferred Experience

Customer-facing analytics products, embedded analytics, or external reporting platforms
AI-powered analytics, conversational analytics, LLMs, or GenAI initiatives
Modern cloud data ecosystems including Snowflake, dbt, and cloud-native analytics platforms
Experience supporting Product, Revenue, Customer Success, and Executive stakeholders

Why Join

Lead a highly visible analytics function
Drive analytics modernization and AI initiatives
Own customer-facing and internal analytics products
Partner directly with executive leadership
Join a team investing heavily in analytics, data products, and AI
Strong growth trajectory with long-term leadership opportunities

If you're an engineering-first analytics leader who loves building modern analytics platforms, scaling teams, and driving business impact through Snowflake, Looker, and data products, we'd love to connect.

jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering & Strategy | Addison, TX
jobs.description:
We are searching for an experienced Data infrastructure & technology leader to oversee a large data warehouse build-out. You would be working in a mid-size org with a highly matrixed team across application owners, data & BI stakeholders, and consultants - the ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting/stage-based priorities. In this position you will be work with a mixed team to maintain old data infrastructure while building out a completely new (greenfield) environment, including a snowflake warehouse, data ingestion, pipelines for internal reporting, connectors with other internal apps/systems.

The ideal person for this position will have strong prior history building out either a data warehouse or similar-complexity project at a medium or large scale. While this position will require technical knowledge and the ability to check the work of engineers, it is primarily a leadership position focused on architecture, strategy, and building relationships and connections across IT & business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology and Analytics
jobs.description:
Company Description
MediLogic is a healthcare technology and analytics company specializing in Risk Adjustment, focused on transforming how organizations use data to drive outcomes. The company delivers meticulously curated, innovative analytics solutions that integrate seamlessly with client operations and address complex business needs. Using advanced strategies and modern technologies, MediLogic helps partners improve both health outcomes and financial performance. The organization values long-term partnerships, client satisfaction, and sustainable growth, viewing them as interconnected drivers of success. Team members join a mission-driven environment committed to building a smarter healthcare analytics future that creates lasting value and a healthier world.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology and Analytics is a full-time, hybrid role based in Albuquerque, NM, with flexibility for part-time work from home. This leader will oversee the design, development, and delivery of technology and analytics solutions, including data platforms, reporting tools, and Risk Adjustment analytics products. Daily responsibilities include setting technology and data strategy, managing engineering and analytics teams, establishing governance standards, and ensuring secure, compliant data practices. The role will partner closely with executive leadership, product, operations, and client-facing teams to align solutions with business objectives, improve client outcomes, and support scalable growth. The Vice President will also monitor emerging technologies, drive continuous improvement, and represent the function in key internal and external stakeholder discussions.
Qualifications

Demonstrated leadership experience in technology and analytics within healthcare, health tech, or a related data-driven industry, ideally with exposure to Risk Adjustment or healthcare analytics.
Proficiency in data strategy and architecture, including experience with data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and modern analytics platforms or cloud ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Strong skills in business intelligence and advanced analytics, such as data visualization, reporting frameworks, and familiarity with statistical or machine learning methods used in healthcare analytics.
Experience overseeing software development or engineering teams, including agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and collaboration with product and operations teams.
Knowledge of healthcare data standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, PHI security, compliance best practices) and experience implementing secure, compliant technology solutions.
Ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts into clear strategies and communications for executive leadership, clients, and cross-functional partners.
Track record of building and mentoring high-performing, diverse teams and fostering a collaborative, inclusive work environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA, MS, MPH, or similar) is preferred.
Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with a focus on measurable

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Franchise Technology Programs
jobs.description:
Description

At FIT House of Brands
, we are driving transformation across our fitness portfolio by delivering seamless, cutting-edge technology solutions to our network. We are seeking a strategic, proactive, and execution-minded Senior Manager, Franchise Technology Programs
to lead our network-facing technology ecosystem and drive high-impact technical initiatives.

In this pivotal role, you will act as the operational owner and architect behind network-wide technology rollouts—including proprietary CRMs, business intelligence platforms, and KPI reporting tools. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, fostering positive and proactive relationships across internal departments, corporate leadership, external vendors, and franchise partners to scale systems that empower franchisees and support sustainable business growth.

Responsibilities

The Senior Manager, Franchise Technology Programs
will be responsible for:

Mindbody Specialist & System Maintenance

Maintain direct, primary responsibility for all internal and external processes associated with Mindbody testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance.
Hold all internal and external parties, engineering teams, and stakeholders consistently accountable to technical deadlines and performance standards.
Act as the primary point of contact and escalation for critical Mindbody-related configurations, troubleshooting, and network support workflows, working closely with the Technology, Performance, and the Global Onboarding and Support teams.
Maintain direct, primary responsibility and act as the primary point of contact for all education support matters relating to Mindbody for both new and existing Franchisees and their studio-level staff, working closely with the Education, Performance, and the Global Onboarding and Support teams.

CRM Architecture & Implementation

Working closely with the Life Cycle Marketing, Performance and Technology teams, to lead the design, development, and system rollout of any CRM platform(s) tailored for each of the FIT House of Brands.
Working closely with the Performance and Life cycle Marketing teams oversee CRM sales process workflows, lead-generation integrations, and automated or AI driven performance/education marketing systems within any CRM platform infrastructure.
Work with internal and external stakeholders to formulate and execute beta tests and pilot programs for any new and all CRM features before network-wide deployment.

Technology Evaluation, Workflows & Special Projects

Work with internal stakeholders where needed on the identification, evaluation, and implementation of secondary technologies designed to optimize studio operational workflows and improve data integrity.
Partner with the Operations Executive Team on high-value corporate technical and operational initiatives.

Vendor Performance & Contract Management

Establish and implement a robust technical vendor performance framework, including regular reviews, scorecards, and accountability loops.
Work with the Technology team and the SVP, Global Product to manage tech vendor contracts from initial discovery up to executive-ready execution.
Work with the Technology team and the SVP, Global Product to ensure any relevant Master/Service Level Agreements (MSAs/SLAs) are rigorously met, and proactively re-negotiate key vendor contracts to optimize cost structures and rebate terms.

Requirements

8+ years of progressive experience in operations, technical project management, or franchise tech systems, with at least 5 years in management or senior project ownership role.
Deep, expert-level familiarity with Mindbody software configurations, enterprise features, and multi-site scheduling ecosystems.
Proven experience architecting and implementing robust CRM ecosystems (workflows, funnels, automations) at scale.
Proven success leading cross-functional projects across multiple corporate departments.
Deep understanding of the fitness and franchising industry is highly preferred.

Benefits

Medical, Vision and Dental benefits
Competitive salary, based on experience
401(k)
Flexible, Unlimited PTO
Casual dress and laid-back work environment
Fun, fitness and health orientated environment

FIT House of Brands is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
